sources.label: nflverse-data release metadata (GitHub Releases API)
sources.publisher: GitHub (authoritative for release asset metadata of nflverse/nflverse-data)
sources.type: official platform API (third-party redistribution of NFL feeds)
sources.how_verified: HTTPS GET from the sandbox (github.com family is reachable); 25 releases fetched. The three tags recorded in data/derived/manifest.json (schedules, stats_player, stats_team) all exist. Of 31 recorded assets, 28 match the manifest byte-for-byte; the 3 rolling 2026 assets (games.parquet, stats_player_week_2026.parquet, stats_team_week_2026.parquet) are larger upstream now than at the 2026-11-02 snapshot, i.e. upstream re-published them after the snapshot.
sources.note: nflverse is a community redistribution of the NFL's own play-by-play/stat feeds; it is the project's price/history source of record and is labelled third-party everywhere.
